caption:
QuickBooks AI now includes expense categorization on all paid tiers — including Essentials, which used to require Advanced. If you correct a few entries, the AI gets better at tagging your expenses, saving you 80% of manual work.

Here’s how to train it:

1. Go to Expenses > Auto-Categorize
2. Correct a few expense categories manually (e.g., "Coffee Run" → "Office Supplies")
3. Confirm corrections to train the AI

No need for separate tools or complex setups — it’s built right into QuickBooks. Accuracy improves the more you correct.

Copy this prompt:

"Categorize these expenses: [paste list here]"

(Use this when you need to manually tag a batch.)

Save this for later, and follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
